# 爬行者治療 此可自訂的伺服器與用戶端插件能使世界自動爬行者爆炸。它可以自訂一個可替換的方塊列表，讓插件知道要用什麼方塊來替換已經毀壞掉的方塊，以便平衡並防止有人濫用此插件。 ## [贊助 Ember Host](https://billing.ember.host/aff.php?aff=21) 如果你正在尋找性價比極高的 Minecraft 伺服器主機，可以試試 Ember Host。你也能在下方使用廣告旗幟支持我的開發——凡第一次購買者，我可以獲得 50% 分成，而你則可享 10% 折扣。
## 特性 ### 爆炸治療模式 額外設定爆炸進一步治療的方式： - **白天治療模式**：讓爆炸等到黎明後才開始治療；治療時需要光源。 - **難度治療模式**：依世界或伺服器難度加速或減緩爆炸治療速度。 - **爆破抗性治療模式**：爆破抗性越高的方塊治療所需時間越久；其延遲也會加入隨機偏移量，造成方塊群聚恢復。 爆炸治療期間，方塊會恢復。如果玩家能在此處放置方塊，該方塊即可恢復。 ### 不同爆炸來源 本插件亦支援治療不同類型的爆炸來源（如怪物、TNT、床以及終界水晶等方塊），你也可以設置怪物的爆炸源黑名單，讓它們不被治療。 ### 令爆炸不掉落物品 你可以個別設定不同爆炸來源是否掉落物品。預設情況下，所有爆炸類型除了怪物爆炸外都不允許掉落物品，但你仍可透過組態檔或指令分別調整。此外也有一个怪物爆炸的黑名單，讓指定怪物爆炸時不掉落物品。 ### 可設定延遲 設定爆炸開始治療所需時間以及各次方塊放置間的時間。注意某些爆炸模式會自行設定爆炸治療和方塊放置的延遲時間。 - **警告**：兩項延遲最小值均為 0.05 秒，若在組態檔中強制將值設得更低，插件會改採用預設值。 ### 恢復方塊實體的 NBT 數據 治療方塊時可切換是否恢復方塊的 NBT 數據。另外你可以選擇強制此方塊無論如何都要治療，以確保原始方塊及其 NBT 數據都能還原。 ### 使掉落方塊不再掉落 治療時讓沙或礫石等方塊保持原位；僅當收到鄰接更新後才會掉落。 ### 白名單 你可設定選填白名單，以指定允許在爆炸中恢復的方塊。做法是打開插件組態檔並找到以下段落： ```toml #Use an optional whitelist to customize which blocks are allowed to heal. To add an entry, specify the block's namespace #along with its identifier, separated by a colon, and add it in-between the square brackets below. Separate each entry with a comma. #Example entries: #whitelist_entries = ["minecraft:grass", "minecraft:stone", "minecraft:sand"] [whitelist] whitelist_entries = ["minecraft:placeholder"] ``` 要將條目加入白名單，你可把包含方塊命名空間及識別碼的字串（中間以冒號分隔）加入陣列中，格式如上例所示，並以逗號分隔各項目。你亦可找到一個名为 “enable_whitelist” 的偏好設定選項，用以啟用或停用白名單。 ### 替換圖 於插件組態檔中你可自訂「替換圖」，如果你希望某一方塊以另一種方塊來代替治療（而不是使用相同方塊）。若以其他方塊取代原方塊進行治療，原始方塊的屬性將會延續至新方塊，保留方位等方塊屬性。 若要加入替換圖條目，請打開位於 config 資料夾內的 `creeper-healing.toml` 組態檔，滾動到底部於 `[replace_map]` 段落後方按下列格式添加每行一個條目： ```toml "minecraft:name_of_old_block" = "minecraft:name_of_new_block" ``` 預設的替換圖中包含以下項目： ```toml "diamond_block" = "minecraft:stone" ``` - **警告**：切勿將同一個方塊替換成多個不同方塊，否則遊戲啟動時可能發生崩潰。也就是說，不要在替換圖中重複使用相同的鍵。 ### 額外設定 你也可切換額外功能的設定，例如： - 治療方塊時是否播放放置音效。 - 透過治療或再生藥水更快地治療爆炸。 ### 指令 所有插件設定皆可於遊玩過程中以指令修改。使用 `/creeper-healing` 主指令即可存取全部設定。組態檔同樣內建 `/creeper-healing reload_config` 指令，無需重啟伺服器或世界即可重新載入組態。注意所有指令皆需要操作員許可權。 ## 組態檔 當伺服器或遊戲啟動時，插件會在遊戲的配置資料夾內搜尋現有的 `creeper-healing.toml` 組態檔。若已存在，便讀取其中的數值；否則就在 `/config/creeper-healing.toml` 建立新的組態檔。你可編輯此文件以設定插件，重啟伺服器或世界以應用更改，或使用 `/creeper-healing reload_config` 指令內重新載入。 以下是當插件首次初始化，或在伺服器或世界關閉時未找到組態檔所產生的預設組態內容： ```toml #Configure the delays related to the healing of explosions. [delays] #(Default = 3.0) How much time in seconds should an explosion wait for to begin healing. explosion_heal_delay = 3.0 #(Default = 1.0) The time in seconds that a block takes to heal. block_placement_delay = 1.0 #Toggle whether certain explosion should drop items. Does not include items stored in container blocks. [explosion_item_drops] #(Default = false) Whether to drop items on explosions caused by mobs such as Creepers. drop_items_on_mob_explosions = false #(Default = true) Whether to drop items on explosions caused by blocks such as beds or end crystal blocks. drop_items_on_block_explosions = true #(Default = true) Whether to drop items on explosions caused by TNT blocks and TNT minecarts. drop_items_on_tnt_explosions = true #(Default = true) Whether to drop items on explosions such as those caused by wind bursts. drop_items_on_triggered_explosions = true #(Default = true) Whether to drop items on explosions whose source is not any of the ones provided in this setting category. drop_items_on_other_explosions = true #Add mob identifiers to this blacklist to prevent explosions caused by the added mobs from dropping items if drop_items_on_mob_explosions is enabled. drop_items_on_mob_explosions_blacklist = ["minecraft:placeholder"] #Configure which explosions are allowed to heal. [explosion_sources] #(Default = true) Heal explosions caused by mobs such as Creepers. heal_mob_explosions = true #(Default = false) Heal explosions caused by blocks such as beds or end crystal blocks. heal_block_explosions = false #(Default = false) Heal explosions caused by TNT blocks and TNT minecarts. heal_tnt_explosions = false #(Default = false) Heal explosions such as those caused by wind bursts. heal_triggered_explosions = false #(Default = false) Heal explosions caused by sources which aren't any of the ones provided in this setting category. heal_other_explosions = false #Add mob identifiers to this blacklist to prevent explosions caused by the added mobs from healing if heal_mob_explosions is enabled. heal_mob_explosions_blacklist = ["minecraft:placeholder"] #Choose between different special modes for explosion healing. Note that certain healing modes will not follow the explosion delay and block delay settings. [explosion_healing_mode] #(Default = "default_mode") Choose any of the following healing modes by copying one of the strings and pasting it into the value of the "mode" setting below: #"default_mode", "daytime_healing_mode", "difficulty_based_healing_mode", "blast_resistance_based_healing_mode" mode = "DEFAULT_MODE" #Toggleable settings for extra features. [preferences] #(Default = false) Whether to restore block nbt data upon healing. This option prevents container blocks like chests from dropping their inventories. Does not apply when the healed block is different from the destroyed block due to a replace map entry. restore_block_nbt = false #(Default = false) Whether to force blocks with nbt data to always heal, even if the replace map specifies a replacement for that block, and regardless of the block that may be occupying that position at the moment of healing. force_blocks_with_nbt_to_always_heal = false #(Default = true) Allows for a falling block, like sand or gravel, to fall when healed. Disabling this option makes the falling block have to receive a neighbor update before falling. make_falling_blocks_fall = true #(Default = true) Whether a block placement sound effect should be played when a block is healed. block_placement_sound_effect = true #(Default = true) Whether a block placement sound effect should produce some cloud particles. block_placement_particles = true #(Default = true) Makes explosion heal immediately when a potion of Healing is thrown on them. heal_on_healing_potion_splash = true #(Default = true) Makes explosions begin their healing process when a potion of Regeneration is thrown on them. heal_on_regeneration_potion_splash = true #(Default = false) Toggle the usage of the whitelist. enable_whitelist = false #Use an optional whitelist to customize which blocks are allowed to heal. To add an entry, specify the block's namespace #along with its identifier, separated by a colon and enclosed in double quotes, and add it in-between the square brackets below. Separate each entry with a comma. #Example entries: #whitelist_entries = ["minecraft:grass", "minecraft:stone", "minecraft:sand"] [whitelist] whitelist = ["minecraft:placeholder"] #Add your own replace entries to configure which blocks should be used to heal other blocks. The block on the right will be used to heal the block on the left. #Specify the block's namespace along with the block's name identifier, separated by a colon and enclosed in double quotes. #Example entry: #"minecraft:gold_block" = "minecraft:stone" #Warning, the same key cannot appear more than once in the replace map! For example, the following will cause an error: #"minecraft:diamond_block" = "minecraft:stone" #"minecraft:diamond_block" = "minecraft:air" [replace_map] "minecraft:diamond_block" = "minecraft:stone" ``` ## 支援 如果你想回報錯誤或提出建議，可透過插件的 [問題追蹤器](https://github.com/ArkoSammy12/creeper-healing/issues) 進行。 ## 鳴謝 - 多謝 [Kioku](https://github.com/takoyakioku) 提供插件圖標。 - 多謝 @sulpherstaer 給我靈感與點子創作此插件。 - Thansk @_jacg 在 Fabric Discord 社群協助我設定自訂組態檔。 - 多謝 @dale8699 協助改善插件並提出構想。
